programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు

programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक योग और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी सुझावों के माध्यम से आध्यात्मिक अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा प्राकृतिक उपचारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए आंतरिक शांति को बढ़ावा देते हैं।.

programme.title: रोगानुसार आयुर्वेद एवं जीवन दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Acharya Balkrishna Ji, a prominent yoga and Ayurveda scholar, talks about the importance of medicinal plants and their uses
programme.desc: प्रमुख योग और आयुर्वेद विद्वान आचार्य बालकृष्ण जी विभिन्न औषधीय पौधों के महत्व और उनके उपयोग के बारे में बात करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी
programme.sub-title: Sant Rajinder Singh Ji Maharaj, current head of Science of Spirituality or Sawan Kirpal Ruhani Mission, is internationally recognised for his work towards inner and outer peace through spirituality
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक संत राजिंदर सिंहजी महाराज आध्यात्मिकता और रहस्यवाद के बारे में प्रवचन देते हैं जो अपने कार्यों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचाने जाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satpal Ji Maharaj's mission is primarily to ignite the spiritual flame in man. The knowledge he teaches, frees one from all restrictions and liberates the mind from all layers of ignorance
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्ति और आत्म-साक्षात्कार से परिचय कराते हैं, तथा दर्शकों को आंतरिक शांति और जीवन के उद्देश्य की गहरी समझ की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: Africa's Super Snake
programme.desc: She has no hands, no arms, no legs, but she'll crush you to death in 15 minutes. She's an African rock python, and she's queen of the constrictors.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.sub-title: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce. For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge that is met with a variety of strategies. In this episode we will observe the creative tactics animals employ to find the best mates and to win them over
programme.desc: Investigating the tactics and strategies used by animals in the wild.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.sub-title: Discover how some of the world's most extraordinary animals are also the smallest. This action-packed episode will take you deep into rainforests, under the oceans and across vast deserts
programme.desc: Bringing you the best in entertainment. We explore the lives of nature's wildest animals from all corners of the world, and see how they have learned to adapt, both to survive and to evolve.

programme.title: Tiger Legacy
programme.sub-title: Maya's new cubs grow into tree climbers. Maya kills a buck, while Matkasur has a fierce fight with a mother sloth
programme.desc: The filmmaker captures the intimate lives of four female tigers and their cubs in Tadoba, India, over seven years, offering a rare look at their behaviors in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.sub-title: As the planet's shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone. It is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising floodwaters
programme.desc: Reveals the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. We examine how massive seasonal events affect the lives of individual animals as their stories develop across the year.

programme.title: Wild Fighters
programme.sub-title: The love rivalry shakes every fibre of the body as hormones invade the blood, and some of the most overwhelming spectacles on the planet are produced; the language of love and the fight for reproduction stimulate the most diverse behaviours
programme.desc: Explores the fights for the survival of various wild creatures and their motivations to win.

programme.title: The Last Refuge
programme.desc: In the Philippines, Aeta tribesmen battle industrial encroachment on ancestral lands.

programme.sub-title: Looks at intricate, trap-like structures that animals build to capture prey
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: The Incredible Five: A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes.

programme.title: A Restless Planet
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: Wild Fighters
programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan
programme.desc: Explores the fights for the survival of various wild creatures and their motivations to win.

programme.title: Wild Wild Bunch
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: Examine the razor-sharp claws, teeth, and senses of these wild killing machines.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.sub-title: The ability to fight and win is essential to any animal living in the wild. The strategies of that fight are known as agonism, and it can be used to establish hierarchy, secure resources, win territory and seduce mates. In the wild, there are no guarantees. But those that master agonism have the best chance of seeing another day
programme.desc: Investigating the tactics and strategies used by animals in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.sub-title: Bears, owls, and tigers use their sharp claws to fight and catch prey, while baboons, wolves and woodchucks use their teeth as weapons
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.sub-title: Gary, Arlie, and Jake search for a gator in an RV park and Shannon finds a timber rattlesnake at a local business. The team trades gators with their sister park in South Padre Island, Texas
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home \"Gator Country.\".

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: Exploring life-defining battles amongst the animal kingdom's greatest rivals. Like gladiatorial battles, the animal showdowns are set in different wild 'arenas', including the Pacific Northwest, African savannah, jungle coasts, and Australia.

programme.title: Viper Queens
programme.desc: Velvet the Gaboon viper and Therma the rattlesnake are two mothers facing different challenges in extreme, contrasting landscapes.

programme.title: The Incredible Five: A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes.

programme.title: The Incredible Five: A Cheetah's Tale
programme.desc: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes.

programme.title: A Restless Planet
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: Wild Fighters
programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan
programme.desc: Explores the fights for the survival of various wild creatures and their motivations to win.

programme.title: Wild Wild Bunch
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: Examine the razor-sharp claws, teeth, and senses of these wild killing machines.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.sub-title: The ability to fight and win is essential to any animal living in the wild. The strategies of that fight are known as agonism, and it can be used to establish hierarchy, secure resources, win territory and seduce mates. In the wild, there are no guarantees. But those that master agonism have the best chance of seeing another day
programme.desc: Investigating the tactics and strategies used by animals in the wild.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.sub-title: Bears, owls, and tigers use their sharp claws to fight and catch prey, while baboons, wolves and woodchucks use their teeth as weapons
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.sub-title: Gary, Arlie, and Jake search for a gator in an RV park and Shannon finds a timber rattlesnake at a local business. The team trades gators with their sister park in South Padre Island, Texas
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home \"Gator Country.\".

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: Experts and cavers investigate a community of dwarf crocodiles living in a series of underground caves in the wilderness of Gabon.

programme.title: Wild Cats
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: From the mighty lions of Africa and the elusive snow leopards of Asia to the pumas of the North American mountains and the jaguars of the Amazon. These stunningly graceful animals are some of the most vicious and territorial on the planet.

programme.title: Africa's Trees of Life
programme.sub-title: Explore the importance of the sausage tree in sub-Saharan Africa's ecosystem and the vital role it plays in providing sustenance and sanctuary for local animals
programme.desc: Explore the importance of certain trees to the ecosystem of sub-Saharan Africa.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.sub-title: The Atlantic Coast, where wild horses battle, bald eagles chase ospreys and sharks protect fish; raccoons navigate city life, black bears search for food in ancient forests and a 130-year-old oak tree prepares for winter's arrival
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event exploring the worlds and wildlife of North and South America, following amazing creatures across frozen mountains, barren deserts and dense jungles in awe-inspiring, never-before-seen footage.

programme.title: Okavango: River of Dreams
programme.sub-title: Follows the life of lioness Fekeetsa as she travels around her territory in the Upper Okavango river
programme.desc: An exploration of the wildlife and landscapes of the Okavango River in Southern Africa, embarking on a journey along the river's path.

programme.title: Beach Jackals
programme.desc: Threatened by Southern Africa's farmers, black-backed jackals find new shelter in the restricted and arid area of Namibia's Skeleton Coast. They adapt to a new lifestyle and learn to cooperate to hunt bigger prey, like fur seals.

programme.title: Lion Queens: Fighting For Survival
programme.desc: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat.

programme.title: Wild Cats
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: From the mighty lions of Africa and the elusive snow leopards of Asia to the pumas of the North American mountains and the jaguars of the Amazon. These stunningly graceful animals are some of the most vicious and territorial on the planet.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last of the Giants
programme.sub-title: Beginning in the Americas, Patrick finds out more about the planet's largest predator, the sperm whale, comes face to face with grizzlies, and gets up close with the anaconda as he reveals how these giants shape their environments
programme.desc: Shot across the continents of Australia, Asia, the Americas and Africa, this three-part nature documentary series delves into the Earth's biggest beasts, from five-ton elephant seals to the dignified African lion. Biologist Patrick Aryee embarks on a global mission to explore the biggest beasts and the conservation challenges that face them in an ever-changing world. Full of beautiful natural history photography, illustrated graphics of extinct gigantic beasts and stunning close encounters, this series looks at why size really does matter in the natural world.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: An unforgettable expedition across diverse landscapes of Africa exploring the fascinating lives of their extraordinary inhabitants.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: We travel from the forests of Hokkaido to the shores of Okinawa to uncover the secrets of Japan's most extraordinary creatures.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.sub-title: The Texas team of gator savers take a paddle boat out for a rescue mission where the hunt for a sneaky gator ends in chest-deep water, and a gator with an eye problem gets a checkup
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home \"Gator Country.\".

programme.title: Hot Life Africa
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a duelling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Hippos After Dark
programme.desc: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark.

programme.title: Secret Ways
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the various secrets methods of survival of different animal species, highlighting their ways of scavenging food and protecting their offsprings.

programme.title: One Wild Day
programme.sub-title: A day in the life of desert animals fighting to survive in some of the world's most extreme environments, revealing elephants setting out on an epic journey, a beetle that likes morning yoga, and a real-life night monster
programme.desc: Capturing 24 hours in the natural world across different environments, witnessing nature's 'rush hour', the high-octane thrill of the hunt, and the eerie world of nocturnal predators as the sun goes down.

programme.title: Cute to Killer
programme.desc: Zimbabwe is the perfect habitat for Africa's finest predator. Follow the development of four cubs, from two weeks to three years old, as they progress from 'Cute to Killer'.

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.sub-title: When a sea monster washes up on an English beach, Jeremy Wade sets off to unmask the beast. His journey takes him to the ice sheets of Greenland and Norway
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

programme.title: Just Animals
programme.desc: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species.

programme.title: Wild By Nature
programme.desc: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.desc: पूज्य वसंत विजय जी महाराज पवित्र शास्त्रों की कहानियों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों से धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने का आग्रह करते हैं।.

programme.title: श्री विनोद जी अग्रवाल
programme.sub-title: Shri Vinodji Agrawal, a religious scholar, provides a detailed discourse on various spiritual teachings to devotees and encourages them to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: धार्मिक विद्वान श्री विनोदजी अग्रवाल भक्तों को विभिन्न आध्यात्मिक शिक्षाओं पर विस्तृत प्रवचन देते हैं तथा उन्हें आस्थावान जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: जोनी सुफी / रमन दीवान स्पेशल
programme.sub-title: A talented musical artist sings a variety of devotional compositions and sacred songs to seek blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली संगीत कलाकार ईश्वर से आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करने के लिए विभिन्न प्रकार की भक्ति रचनाएँ और पवित्र गीत गाते हैं।.

programme.title: ज़ेबरा
programme.sub-title: A bank employee with exceptional street smarts gets entangled in a high-stakes financial mess after helping his girlfriend, earning the wrath of an egoistic millionaire
programme.desc: असाधारण चतुराई वाला एक बैंक कर्मचारी अपनी प्रेमिका की मदद करने के बाद एक बड़े वित्तीय संकट में फँस जाता है और एक अहंकारी करोड़पति का निशाना बनता है।.

credits.actor: Satyadev Kancharana,Priya Bhavani Shankar,Dhananjaya,Amrutha Iyengar,Jeniffer Piccinato,Sunil,Satya,Kalyani Natarajan

programme.title: लाबम
programme.sub-title: After returning to his hometown from exile, Pakkiri challenges Vanagamudi, the village chief. Soon, with the locals' support he tries to overhaul the village's farming techniques
programme.desc: निर्वासन से अपने गृह नगर लौटने के बाद, पाक्किरी, गांव के मुखिया वनगामुडी को चुनौती देता है। जल्द ही, स्थानीय लोगों के समर्थन से वह गांव की खेती की तकनीकों को सुधारने की भी कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Vijay Sethupathi,Jagapathi Babu,Shruti Haasan,Dhansika,Kalaiyarasan,Ramesh Thilak,Harish Uthaman,G. Marimuthu

programme.title: पीपली लाइव

programme.desc: नाथा किसानों का मुआवजा पाने के लिए आत्महत्या करने का फैसला करता। हालांकि, मीडिया और नेता उसके इरादों के बारे में जानने के लिए और दुर्लभ घटना पर कब्जा करने के लिए उनके गांव में आ धमकते है।.

programme.title: फाइनल डेस्टिनेशन ब्लडलाइन्स
programme.sub-title: Plagued by a violent recurring nightmare, college student Stefani heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle and save her family
programme.desc: स्टेफनी, एक कॉलेज छात्रा, एक बार-बार आने वाले बुरे सपने से पीड़ित है। इसके बाद, वह उस व्यक्ति को खोजने के प्रयास में अपने गृहनगर लौटती है जो उसके परिवार को उनके क्रूर भाग्य से बचने में मदद कर सकता है।.

credits.director: Adam Stein,Zach Lipovsky,Guy Busick,Lori Evans Taylor

programme.sub-title: A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world
programme.desc: एक युवती व्यक्तिगत चुनौतियों का सामना करते हुए रहस्यमय शक्तियों को खोज निकालती है। इसी बीच, जैसे-जैसे बुराई बढ़ता है, उसे बदलती दुनिया में अपनी शक्तियों और भाग्य को स्वीकार करना पड़ता है।.

programme.title: सितारे ज़मीन पर
programme.sub-title: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life
programme.desc: शराब पीकर गाड़ी चलाने के कारण, एक बास्केटबॉल कोच को न्यूरोडाइवर्जेंट वयस्कों को सामुदायिक सेवा के लिए प्रशिक्षित करना पड़ता है। जहां उसका प्रारंभिक पूर्वाग्रह दूर होता है।.

credits.actor: Aamir Khan (Gulshan),Genelia Deshmukh,Anup Kumar Mishra (Friend),Brijendra Kala,Dolly Ahluwalia,Happy Ranajit (Surendra),Aroush Datta (Satbir),Rishabh Jain (Raju)

programme.title: रैम्पेज
programme.sub-title: A primatologist shares an unshakable bond with a rare albino silverback gorilla. But a rogue genetic experiment gone awry mutates this gentle ape into a raging creature of enormous size
programme.desc: एक प्राइमेटोलॉजिस्ट का दुर्लभ एल्बिनो सिल्वरबैक गोरिल्ला के साथ अटूट रिश्ता है। लेकिन अनियंत्रित आनुवंशिक प्रयोग के गलत परिणाम से यह शांत स्वभाव का बंद उग्र प्राणी में बदल जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: A compilation of the best cases investigated in 'Crime Patrol' showcases people from different walks of life falling victim to the vices of others or their own
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: In Panama's dense jungle, a former police officer and a free spirit struggle to connect. However, as survival challenges mount, one falters, leaving the other to forage and hunt
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: Survival experts Cody Lundin and Dave Canterbury take on the planet's most unforgiving terrains and demonstrate valuable survival skills.

credits.actor: Paul Christie,E.J. Snyder,Jeff Zausch,Grady Powell,Josh James,Bill McConnell,Joseph Teti,Matt Graham,Cody Lundin,Dave Canterbury

programme.title: Man vs. Wild
programme.desc: The host tackles some of the most gruelling trials, while navigating remote global terrains and sharing essential survival tactics.

programme.title: Marooned With Ed Stafford
programme.desc: Ed Stafford embarks on global adventures with only video equipment, facing survival challenges without food or water in various locations worldwide.

programme.title: Running Wild With Bear Grylls
programme.desc: Survivalist Bear Grylls takes popular stars on a rigorous journey where they are faced with inhospitable conditions in order to survive.

credits.actor: Bear Grylls,Channing Tatum,Rob Riggle,Bobby Bones,Zac Efron

programme.title: 18 Wheels Across Vietnam
programme.desc: Host Dawid Andres travels across Vietnam to examine the country's special traditions, unique cuisine and notable locations.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: Krish, the reincarnation of Lord Krishna, is sent to safeguard the children of Mathura orphanage. There, he fights against the evil principal, Kanishk, in his own mischievous and inimitable way
programme.desc: भगवान कृष्ण के अवतार क्रिस को मथुरा अनाथालय के बच्चों की रक्षा के लिए भेजा जाता है। वहाँ वह अपने शरारती और अनोखे अंदाज़ में दुष्ट प्रिंसिपल कनिष्क के खिलाफ लड़ता है।.

programme.title: एकान्स: स्नेक्स अवेक
programme.sub-title: Ekans, a street-smart prodigy, is chosen by the world's most powerful snakes and gifted with a magical stone. Soon, with his heightened senses, he aspires to protect humanity from evil
programme.desc: एकांस, एक तेज-तर्रार लड़का है, जिसे दुनिया के शक्तिशाली सांपों द्वारा चुना जाता है और उसे एक जादुई पत्थर दिया जाता है। जल्द ही, अपनी तीव्र इंद्रियों के बल पर, वह मानवता को बुराई से बचाने निकलता है।.

programme.title: मिस्टर बीन: दी ऐनमेटिड सिरीज
programme.sub-title: Mr Bean, a fastidious bachelor who lives with Teddy, his stuffed brown bear, finds unconventional ways to do seemingly normal tasks and often gets into trouble with his landlady, Mrs Wicket
programme.desc: एक नकचढ़ा कुंवारा व्यक्ति मिस्टर बीन अपने भूरे भालू टेडी के साथ रहते हुए सामान्य से दिखने वाले कार्य करने के लिए अपरंपरागत तरीके खोजता है और अक्सर मकान मालकिन मिसेज विकेट के साथ परेशानी में पड़ता है।.

programme.title: मिस्टर बीन: दी ऐनमेटिड सिरीज
programme.sub-title: Mr Bean, a fastidious bachelor who lives with Teddy, his stuffed brown bear, finds unconventional ways to do seemingly normal tasks and often gets into trouble with his landlady, Mrs Wicket

programme.title: क्रिस रोल नंबर 21
programme.sub-title: Krish, the reincarnation of Lord Krishna, is sent to safeguard the children of Mathura orphanage. There, he fights against the evil principal, Kanishk, in his own mischievous and inimitable way
programme.desc: भगवान कृष्ण के अवतार क्रिस को मथुरा अनाथालय के बच्चों की रक्षा के लिए भेजा जाता है। वहाँ वह अपने शरारती और अनोखे अंदाज़ में दुष्ट प्रिंसिपल कनिष्क के खिलाफ लड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Pooja Punjabi,Vinod Kulkarni,Gaurav Pareek,Laxmi Narayan Pareek,Narayan Pareek

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: हड्डी मेरा बड्डी
programme.sub-title: Billy and Mandy befriend Haddi after beating him at a limbo match. Later, they use his supernatural abilities to achieve their goals
programme.desc: बिली और मैंडी, हड्डी को लिम्बो मैच में हराने के बाद उससे दोस्ती कर लेते हैं। बाद में, वे अपने मकसद पूरे करने के लिए उसकी अलौकिक शक्तियों का इस्तेमाल करते हैं।.

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: क्रिस रोल नंबर 21
programme.sub-title: Krish, the reincarnation of Lord Krishna, is sent to safeguard the children of Mathura orphanage. There, he fights against the evil principal, Kanishk, in his own mischievous and inimitable way
programme.desc: भगवान कृष्ण के अवतार क्रिस को मथुरा अनाथालय के बच्चों की रक्षा के लिए भेजा जाता है। वहाँ वह अपने शरारती और अनोखे अंदाज़ में दुष्ट प्रिंसिपल कनिष्क के खिलाफ लड़ता है।.

programme.title: शॉन द शीप
programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer
programme.desc: शॉन, अपने भेड़ दोस्तों के समूह के साथ एक बाड़े में रहता है, जो उसे एक नेता के रूप में देखते हैं। शॉन हमेशा उन्हें परेशानी से बचाता है।.

credits.actor: John Sparkes (Bitzer),Justin Fletcher (Shaun),Kate Harbour (Timmy's Mother),Richard Webber (Shirley),Jo Allen (Timmy's Mother)

programme.title: एकान्स: स्नेक्स अवेक
programme.sub-title: Ekans, a street-smart prodigy, is chosen by the world's most powerful snakes and gifted with a magical stone. Soon, with his heightened senses, he aspires to protect humanity from evil
programme.desc: एकांस, एक तेज-तर्रार लड़का है, जिसे दुनिया के शक्तिशाली सांपों द्वारा चुना जाता है और उसे एक जादुई पत्थर दिया जाता है। जल्द ही, अपनी तीव्र इंद्रियों के बल पर, वह मानवता को बुराई से बचाने निकलता है।.

programme.title: मिस्टर बीन: दी ऐनमेटिड सिरीज
programme.sub-title: Mr Bean, a fastidious bachelor who lives with Teddy, his stuffed brown bear, finds unconventional ways to do seemingly normal tasks and often gets into trouble with his landlady, Mrs Wicket
programme.desc: एक नकचढ़ा कुंवारा व्यक्ति मिस्टर बीन अपने भूरे भालू टेडी के साथ रहते हुए सामान्य से दिखने वाले कार्य करने के लिए अपरंपरागत तरीके खोजता है और अक्सर मकान मालकिन मिसेज विकेट के साथ परेशानी में पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Rowan Atkinson (Mr. Bean),Gary Martin (Additional Voices),Matilda Ziegler (Irma Gobb),Sally Grace (Additional Voices),Jon Glover (Additional Voices),Enn Reitel (Additional Voices),Susie Blake (Additional Voices)

programme.desc: இந்த சிறுவர் கார்ட்டூனில், குட்டி ஹக்கா தனது மாயாஜால தொப்பியைக் கொண்டு இயற்கையின் எதிரிகளை எதிர்த்துப் போராடுகிறாள்.

credits.actor: Joy Jackson,Alysa Kees,Natasha Kees,George Kees,Scotty Prysko,Brandy Nicole Spohn

programme.title: ஹெய்டி
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: பிராங்பேர்ட்டிலுள்ள ஹெய்டி, தோழி கிளராவின் கிராமத்திலுள்ள தாத்தா வீட்டிற்கு சென்றுவந்த பின், மீண்டும் செல்ல ஏங்குகிறாள்.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: லிட்டில் க்ரிஷ்ணா

programme.desc: பிருந்தாவனத்தில் கிருஷ்ணன் கிராமவாசிகளை அவர்கள் மீது அசுரர்களை அனுப்பும் தீய கம்சனிடமிருந்து காப்பாற்ற முயல்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: பஞ்சதந்திர கதைகள்
programme.desc: A collection of animal fables in Sanskrit verse and prose that imparts valuable moral lessons and fosters ethical growth through engaging narratives.

programme.title: ஜாக்கி சானின் சாகசங்கள்
programme.desc: An amateur archaeologist working at a local university finds a shield containing a powerful amulet. However, this puts him on the radar of a criminal group.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు

programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.title: లిటిల్ హక్కా
programme.sub-title: Little Hakka uses her magical 'Hakka Hat' to fight evil forces threatening nature in an animated children's adventure story
programme.desc: లిటిల్ హక్కా యానిమేటెడ్ పిల్లల సాహస కథలో ప్రకృతిని బెదిరించే దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడడానికి 'హక్కా టోపీ'ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

credits.actor: Joy Jackson,Alysa Kees,Natasha Kees,George Kees,Scotty Prysko,Brandy Nicole Spohn

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ హక్కా
programme.sub-title: Little Hakka uses her magical 'Hakka Hat' to fight evil forces threatening nature in an animated children's adventure story

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: అకిరా మరియు మోగ్లీ: ది జంగిల్ బుక్ సాహసాలు
programme.desc: Akira Mariyu Mowgli: The Jungle Book Sahasaalu.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: सम्पत चम्पत
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: सम्पत और चम्पत, दो चोर, लगातार ऐसी गड़बड़ योजनाएँ बनाते रहते हैं जो उन्हीं पर भारी पड़ जाती हैं, और जिसके चलते वे स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ कभी न खत्म होने वाली मुसीबतों में फँस जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम क्लाउन टाउन में शोडाउन
programme.sub-title: A brave young police officer ventures into Clown Town, facing mischievous villains and overcoming challenges, proving his courage and determination to restore order and justice
programme.desc: एक बहादुर पुलिस ऑफिसर, क्लाउन टाउन में जाता है और शरारती विलेन का सामना करते हुए चुनौतियों को पार करता है। वह व्यवस्था और न्याय वापस लाने के लिए अपनी हिम्मत और पक्के इरादे को साबित करता है।.

programme.title: आफ्रिकाज सूपर स्नेक
programme.sub-title: The African rock python's aggression, its gruesome man-eating tendencies and its unique constriction skills make it one of the most feared predators of the continent
programme.desc: अफ्रीकी रॉक पाइथन की आक्रामकता, इसकी भयानक मानव-भक्षी प्रवृत्ति और इसकी अद्वितीय संकुचन कौशल इसे महाद्वीप के सबसे अधिक भयभीत शिकारियों में से एक बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: सरवाइव द वाइल्ड
programme.sub-title: For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पुराने फुटेज और ग्राफिक्स के माध्यम से जंगल में शिकार करने और जीवित रहने के लिए जानवरों द्वारा इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली विभिन्न तकनीकों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Explores the Atlantic coast, where wild horses battle, bald eagles chase ospreys, sharks protect fish, raccoons navigate city life, and black bears search for food
programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event from the executive producers of Planet Earth, exploring the extraordinary worlds and wildlife of North and South America. Scored by composer Hans Zimmer, the breathtaking journey follows amazing creatures living in their natural habitats across the supercontinent, including diverse terrains like the Atlantic Coast, Mexico, Wild West, Amazon, Frozen North, Gulf Coast, Andes, Caribbean, West Coast and Patagonia. Each location comes alive in never-before-seen footage showing the unique connectedness of the land that millions of people call home.

programme.title: ओकवांगो: रिवर ऑफ ड्रीम्स

programme.title: एनिमल्स एट नाइट
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: टेक्सास गेटर सेवर्स
programme.sub-title: The team boards a paddle boat to reach a survivor during a low-tech rescue mission. Meanwhile, the crew is lured into deep water by an elusive alligator as a wounded beast receives medical care

programme.title: द विदा एन एल अफ्रीका आर्डियंटे
programme.sub-title: Take look at some of the tricks employed by cheetahs in order to protect themselves from the scorching sun in the wilderness
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता दुनिया के सबसे गर्म क्षेत्रों में जलवायु परिवर्तन के खतरे पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और बताते हैं कि कैसे जानवरों ने बदलते पर्यावरण के साथ खुद को समायोजित किया है।.

programme.title: बैटल ऑफ दी अल्फ़ाज़
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशु साम्राज्य की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के बीच संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करते हैं और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के पीछे के उद्देश्यों को समझने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: बैटल ऑफ दी अल्फ़ाज़
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker documents the conflict between various species of the animal kingdom and understands the motives behind the rivalry
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशु साम्राज्य की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के बीच संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करते हैं और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के पीछे के उद्देश्यों को समझने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: सीक्रेट वेज़
programme.sub-title: Wild life experts offer detailed insights into the unique features of Hyenas, which enable them to thrive amidst the challenges of their habitats
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार विभिन्न पशु प्रजातियों के जीवित रहने के विभिन्न गुप्त तरीकों पर प्रकाश डालते हुए उनके भोजन को साफ करने और अपनी संतानों की रक्षा करने के तरीकों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: वन वाइल्ड डे
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker documents a full day in the lives of various wild animals as they struggle to thrive in some of the harshest environments on planet earth
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार विभिन्न जंगली जानवरों के जीवन के एक पूरे दिन को फिल्माते हैं, जिसमें पृथ्वी के सबसे कठिन वातावरण में जीवित रहने के लिए उनके संघर्ष को दिखाया जाता है।.

programme.title: क्यूट टू किलर
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker chronicles the journey of four cubs in Zimbabwe, home to Africa's top predators, as they grow from two weeks to three-year-old hunters, evolving from 'cute to killer'
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता अफ्रीका के शिकारियों के घर ज़िम्बाब्वे में चार शावकों की यात्रा के बारे में बताते हैं, जहाँ वे दो हफ़्ते के प्यारे से बच्चों से तीन साल के खतरनाक शिकारी बनते हैं।.

programme.title: रिवर मॉन्स्टर्स
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade sets out to investigate a sea monster that has washed up on an English beach. His journey takes him to the ice sheets of Greenland and the fjords of Norway
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता जो एक जीवविज्ञानी और मछुआरा हैं, वे कई मिथकों को खत्म करने और उनसे जुड़ी खौफ़नाक कहानियों को जानने के लिए मीठे पानी के रहस्यों और स्थानीय लोककथाओं की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: कांगा पैन: एन अफ़्रीकन हॉरर स्टोरी
programme.sub-title: A mature resident baboon assists in uncovering the predator that brutally targeted many animals who attempted to quench their thirst at an oasis in Mana Pools National Park, Zimbabwe
programme.desc: स्थानीय बबून जिम्बाब्वे के माना पूल्स राष्ट्रीय उद्यान में एक मरूद्यान में अपनी प्यास बुझाने वाले कई जानवरों को क्रूरतापूर्वक निशाना बनाने वाले शिकारी को पकड़ने में मदद करता है।.

programme.title: वाईल्ड ईटली,वाईल्ड इटली: टॉप प्रिडेटर्स

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क

programme.title: लाइफ अमंग लायन्स
programme.sub-title: A naturalist and ethologist lives among a pride of wild animals where he observes and documents their fascinating and unusual behaviours, developing a deep connection with the animals

Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.sub-title: Krystal began overeating to shield herself with a protective layer of obesity after suffering years of abuse. Once a means of protection, her pathological eating now threatens to destroy her life if she doesn't get help
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.sub-title: Captains scramble to meet an expanded quota in the path of a violent system dubbed Squall-pocalypse. A breakdown on the Wizard puts Monte in debt to the Time Bandit and Josh and Casey exceed their own quota when it comes to injuries on deck
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.sub-title: Alex uses undercover stooges and some wickedly clever manipulation to persuade a contributor their moral compass has been removed by subliminal messaging
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: In Panama's dense jungle, a former police officer and a free spirit struggle to connect. However, as survival challenges mount, one falters, leaving the other to forage and hunt
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: రెస్క్యూ డాన్
programme.sub-title: Following a crash during the Vietnam War, fighter pilot Dieter gets caught by peasants. In captivity, he hatches and executes an escape plan with five deranged prisoners only to face bigger hurdles
programme.desc: వియత్నాం యుద్ధంలో రైతుల చేతిలో చిక్కుకున్న ఫైటర్ పైలట్ తప్పించుకోడానికి చేసే ప్రయత్నంలో అడ్డంకులు ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

credits.actor: Christian Bale (Dieter Dengler),Steve Zahn (Duane),Jeremy Davies (Gene),Galen Yuen (Y.C.),Abhijati \"Meuk\" Jusakul (Phisit),Chaiyan \"Lek\" Chunsuttiwat (Procet),Teerawat \"Ka-Ge\" Mulvilai (Little Hitler),Yuttana Muenwaja (Crazy Horse),Kriangsak Ming-Olo (Jumbo),Pat Healy (Norman),Toby Huss (Spook)

programme.title: ఇంటు ది వైల్డ్ విత్ బేర్ గ్రిల్స్ అండ్ సూపర్‌స్టార్ రజనీకాంత్
programme.sub-title: Survivalist Bear Grylls and superstar Rajinikanth embark on a joint expedition to explore the Indian jungles and wilderness

programme.sub-title: The host tackles some of the most gruelling trials, while navigating remote global terrains and sharing essential survival tactics
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత కఠినమైన, మారుమూల ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రయాణిస్తూ, ప్రేక్షకులతో మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the logistics and rituals related to the Kumbh Mela, a pilgrimage that attracts large crowds of worshippers seeking salvation
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత, మోక్షాన్ని కోరుకునే భక్తులను ఆకర్షించే కుంభమేళాకు సంబంధించిన నిర్వహణ ఏర్పాట్లు, ఆచారాల గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: सांत्वनी-सुप्रभ सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन

programme.title: संतवाणी-प्रणम्य सागर जी महाराज

programme.sub-title: A famous religious leader sings hymns in praise of Lord Krishna in front of devotees in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace in them
programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्तों में शांति की भावना पैदा करने के लिए उनके सामने भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य गुरु मी मां जी
programme.sub-title: Pujya Guru Mee Maa ji

programme.title: सत्संग-अमृत
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader explores the path to a pious life through the wisdom of Hinduism, sharing timeless precepts as well as teachings
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के ज्ञान के माध्यम से पवित्र जीवन के मार्ग की खोज कर, कालातीत उपदेशों के साथ-साथ शिक्षाओं को भी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the benefits of 'Ayurveda' and shares various treatments to help patients suffering from various ailments
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, 'आयुर्वेद' के लाभों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विभिन्न बीमारियों से पीड़ित रोगियों की मदद के लिए विभिन्न उपचार बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मोरारी बापू
programme.sub-title: Morari Bapu reads out and explains significant excerpts from the Rama Katha while giving his interpretation of the same and highlighting its importance
programme.desc: मोरारी बापू रामकथा के महत्वपूर्ण अंश पढ़ते और समझाते हैं, साथ ही उसकी अपनी व्याख्या और उसके महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी

programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले

programme.title: मिनरल गुरु

programme.title: வன்முறை
programme.sub-title: The host provides a detailed insight into some of the greatest wars in history and the impact it had on the society and people
programme.desc: வரலாற்றில் நடந்த மிகப் பெரிய போர்கள் மற்றும் சமூகம்-மக்கள் மீது அது ஏற்படுத்திய தாக்கம் பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவை வழங்குகிறது.

programme.title: ஜன்னலுக்கு வெளியே
programme.sub-title: A roundup of all the events taking place in Chennai, India, including special guests who share their personal stories and give an insight into their lives
programme.desc: சென்னையில் நடைபெறும் நிகழ்வில் விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனிப்பட்ட கதைகள்-வாழ்வை பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவை பகிர்ந்துகொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆன்மீகம் வளர்த்த அருளாளர்கள்

programme.title: நூல் அரங்கம்

programme.title: தாலாட்டு
programme.sub-title: Dr Revathi comes to her village to help people and yearns for the love of Chelladurai, a renowned man, who detests her and cannot wait to humiliate her
programme.desc: மக்களுக்கு உதவ தனது கிராமத்திற்கு திரும்பும் டாக்டர் ரேவதி அங்கு செல்லதுரையின் அன்பிற்கு ஏங்கும் அவளை அவனோ வெறுக்கிறான்.

credits.actor: Arvind Swamy (Kuzhanthai),Sukanya (Dr. Revathi),Sivaranjini (Malli),Goundamani (Goundar),Vijaya Kumar (Dr. Revathi's father),Kovai Sarala (Goundar's wife),Mansoor Ali Khan (Chelladurai),Poornam Vishwanathan (Dr. Revathi's grandfather)

programme.title: நடன அரங்கம்
programme.sub-title: Immerse yourself in the grace and beauty of Indian classical dances as gifted artists perform enchanting Bharatanatyam and Odissi numbers
programme.desc: பரதநாட்டியம் மற்றும் ஒடிசி நடனங்களை கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்தும்போது, ​​இந்திய பாரம்பரிய நடனங்களின் அழகில் மூழ்கிவிடுங்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி மாலை
programme.sub-title: Various talented music artists and vocalists perform some of the most revered devotional songs in praise of the Almighty
programme.desc: பல்வேறு திறமையான இசைக்கலைஞர்களும் பாடகர்களும் இறைவனைப் போற்றும் சில பக்திப் பாடல்களைப் தொடர்ந்து பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: நாத சங்கமம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned singers and musicians perform a collection of melodious classical songs written by prolific artists and songwriters
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற பாடகர்கள், இசைக்கலைஞர்கள்-பாடலாசிரியர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட மெல்லிசை கிளாசிக்கல் பாடல்களை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.

programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders along with devotees recite morning prayers, conduct rituals and sing devotional songs in praise of various Hindu deities
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்
programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் அழகு, மரபுகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரங்களை சித்தரிக்கும் ஒரு சிறப்பு தேசபக்தி பாடலை நிகழ்த்தும் பாடகர்கள் குழு.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A melodious rendering of a hymn composed in praise of Lord Murugan is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: பக்தி உணர்வைத் தூண்டும் வகையில், முருகப் பெருமானைப் புகழ்ந்து இயற்றப்பட்ட ஒரு பாடலின் மெல்லிசைப் பாடல் இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலயதர்சனம்

programme.desc: గొప్ప ప్రాచీన సాధువు శంకరాచార్యుల వారు రచించిన సంస్కృత శ్లోకం శ్రీ నారాయణ స్తోత్రాన్ని అందించే కార్యక్రమం.

programme.title: శ్రీ గణేశ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs and hymns dedicated to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles
programme.desc: సకల విఘ్నాలను తొలగించే వినాయకుడికి అంకితం చేసిన అత్యంత ప్రజాదరణ పొందిన గీతాలు, శ్లోకాల సమగ్ర సంకలనం ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ లక్ష్మీ సహస్రనామం

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்

programme.desc: பிரபல இந்திய செஃப், ஆஸ்திரியா முழுதும் பயணித்து ​​நல்ல உணவு மற்றும் மோட்டார் பைக்குகள் மீதான தன் ஆர்வத்தை காட்டுகிறார்.

programme.title: ட்ராவல் டைரீஸ் ஆஃப் ஹீலர் அண்ட் ரோஹன்
programme.sub-title: Rohan sets out to go paragliding over the picturesque Kumaon mountains of Uttarakhand. He wonders if his partner-in-crime will join him too
programme.desc: அழகிய நிலப்பரப்புகள், நகரங்களை ஆராய்ந்து, உத்தரகாண்ட் முழுவதும் தங்கள் பயணங்களை மேற்கொள்ளும் ரோஹன் மற்றும் ஹீலர்.

programme.title: வெல் சீசண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Watch some international and Indian dishes craftily combined to make some mouth-watering fusion recipes being prepared by Chef Palani
programme.desc: பாரம்பரிய பொருட்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி பல்வேறு வகையான சுவையான உணவுகளைத் தயாரிக்கும் சமையல் நிபுணர் பழனி முருகன்.

programme.title: வர்ல்ட் ஸ்பாஸ்
programme.sub-title: Nestled on the serene banks of Lake Vembanad and cocooned by nature, Kumarakom Lake Resort is renowned as one of the finest luxury heritage resorts in India
